title: Chemical tanker sheen at Hazira
description: A 5.6 km² slick was detected off Hazira anchorage. The top suspect chemical tanker overlaps the backward drift cone at 92% and recorded a 47-minute AIS blackout.

title: Residual sheen near Vadinar SPM
description: A 2.9 km² residual sheen was detected on the Vadinar single point mooring approach with two candidate vessels.
